source: 至少预留 5 GB；实际准备前会按所选游戏文件大小再次检查空间，可选择空间更大的游戏库磁盘。
en: Keep at least 5 GB free. Before preparation, space is checked again against the selected game files. Choose a library disk with more space if needed.

source: 请在 Apple Silicon Mac 的本机桌面会话中运行；系统图形驱动随 macOS 更新提供。
en: Run in a local desktop session on an Apple Silicon Mac. System graphics drivers are provided by macOS updates.

source: 这些组件随完整应用提供，无需另装 Python、Homebrew 或 .NET。请从官方 Release 重新下载 DMG，将完整应用复制到“应用程序”后重新检查；不要只复制可执行文件。
en: These components are included in the full app; separate Python, Homebrew or .NET installations are not required. Download the DMG again from the official release, copy the complete app into Applications, then check again. Copying only the executable is insufficient.

source: 选择可读写且允许执行程序的本地或外置磁盘，保持磁盘连接；在设置中重新选择游戏库。
en: Choose a writable local or external disk that allows program execution, keep it connected, and select the library again in Settings.

source: 需要 Apple Silicon Mac，Intel Mac 或 Rosetta 下运行不受支持。
en: An Apple Silicon Mac is required. Intel Macs and running under Rosetta are unsupported.

source: 验证随应用提供的组件版本清单
en: Validate the component version manifest included with the app

source: 准备游戏需要完整工具链；启动已准备好的游戏只需要标有“启动”的项目。首次安装请先完成全部检查。
en: Preparing games requires the full toolchain. Prepared games only need items marked for launching. Complete all checks during initial setup.

source: 打开 Xcode 完成设置
正在逐项验证环境，请稍候…
构建与启动环境均已就绪
en: Build and runtime environments are ready

source: 可启动已准备的游戏，构建环境仍需修复
en: Prepared games can launch; build tools still need attention

source: 完成环境检查后再导入游戏
en: Complete environment checks before importing games

source:
1. 获取完整 Xcode，打开一次，完成许可与初始组件安装。
2. 选择 Xcode.app 并重新检查，缺少 Metal 时点击安装。
3. 展开每项“安装与修复方法”查看具体步骤，全部通过后继续。
en:
1. Install the full Xcode app, open it once, accept its license and finish initial component installation.
2. Select Xcode.app and check again. Install Metal if it is missing.
3. Expand Installation and repair for each item. Continue after all checks pass.

source: Python、Python 扩展、.NET、NSP 读取器和着色器转换工具均随应用提供，并检查实际运行能力。无需另装系统 Python 或 Homebrew；内置组件缺失或损坏时请重装完整应用。
en: Python, Python extensions, .NET, the NSP reader and shader tools are bundled and tested for actual operation. Separate system Python or Homebrew installations are not required. Reinstall the full app if a bundled component is missing or damaged.

source: 内置 Python 缺失或不可执行，请重新安装完整应用。
en: Bundled Python is missing or not executable. Reinstall the complete app.

source: 内置 Python 无法启动环境检查
en: Bundled Python could not start environment checks

source: Python 随完整应用提供，无需另装系统 Python。请从官方 Release 重新下载 DMG，将完整应用复制到“应用程序”后重新检查。
en: Python is included with the complete app; a separate system Python installation is not required. Download the DMG from the official release, copy the full app into Applications, and check again.

source: 请先安装完整 Xcode 并完成初始设置。
en: Install the full Xcode app and complete its initial setup first.

source: 随应用安装位置动态解析，以下是当前完整路径。
en: Resolved from the current app location. The full path below is for this installation.

source: 随应用提供，可离线阅读
en: Included with the app for offline reading

source: 说明文件缺失或损坏，请重新安装完整应用。
en: The guide is missing or damaged. Reinstall the complete app.

source: 打开所选 Xcode，完成许可及必需系统组件设置。若已完成，可先退出并重新打开璃游，或点击“重新检查”。仍未通过时查看下方诊断；确需手动初始化时，先阅读并同意 Xcode 许可再执行修复命令，它会安装系统组件并接受许可。
en: Open the selected Xcode and finish its license and required system component setup. If setup is already complete, quit and reopen LumaDock or click Check again first. If it still fails, review the diagnostics below. When manual initialization is needed, read and agree to Xcode's license before running the repair command; it installs system components and accepts the license.

source: 请先安装并选择完整 Xcode，再检查初始设置。
en: Install and select the full Xcode app before checking initial setup.

source: Xcode 首次启动组件已就绪
Xcode 初始设置检查超时，请稍后重新检查。
en: The Xcode initial setup check timed out. Check again later.

source: Xcode 许可尚未完成，请打开所选 Xcode 阅读并同意许可。
en: Xcode license acceptance is pending. Open the selected Xcode to read and agree to its license.

source: Xcode 首次启动任务未完成，或状态检查命令执行失败。
en: Xcode first-launch tasks are incomplete, or its status check command failed.

source: 已复制修复命令，请在终端中手动执行。
en: Repair command copied. Run it manually in Terminal.

source: 可稍后在设置中继续。环境检查通过后才能导入和准备游戏。
en: Resume setup in Settings at any time. Environment checks must pass before importing or preparing games.

source: Python、Python 扩展、.NET 运行时、SPIRV-Cross 和 Zstandard 随应用提供。nxnative 及其读取器、翻译器不内置；首次准备引擎工具还需要 .NET 10 SDK，安装方法见环境说明。
en: Python, its extensions, the .NET runtime, SPIRV-Cross and Zstandard are bundled. nxnative, its reader and translator are external. Preparing engine tools for the first time also requires the .NET 10 SDK; see the environment guide.

source: nxnative 目录不可用，请连接磁盘或重新选择目录。
en: The nxnative directory is unavailable. Reconnect its drive or select it again.
The nxnative directory is incomplete. Missing:

source: 复制引擎到私有工作目录
复制期间引擎源码发生变化，请重新准备。
en: Engine sources changed while copying. Prepare the tools again.

source: 外部引擎工具尚未准备或源码已变化，请点击“准备引擎工具”。
en: External engine tools are not ready or the sources changed. Click Prepare engine tools.

source: 外部引擎工具缓存不完整，请重新准备引擎工具。
en: The external engine tool cache is incomplete. Prepare engine tools again.

source: 外部引擎或其私有工具缓存的当前位置。
en: Current location of the external engine or its private tool cache.

source: 外部引擎读取工具已就绪
尚未选择 nxnative 目录，请先在环境设置中指定。
en: No nxnative directory is selected. Choose it in environment settings first.

source: 已验证外部 nxnative 目录及构建接口
en: External nxnative directory and build interfaces verified

source: 应用不附带或下载 nxnative。请自行下载并解压完整源码，再选择包含 dm 和 scripts 的根目录。原目录保持不变，构建使用私有副本。
en: LumaDock does not bundle or download nxnative. Obtain and extract its complete sources yourself, then select the root containing dm and scripts. Builds use private copies and leave your directory unchanged.

source: 引擎目录包含指向外部的符号链接，请选择完整的本地源码副本。
en: The engine contains a symlink outside its directory. Select a complete local source copy.

source: 引擎读取工具编译后无法启动，请查看日志。
en: The compiled engine reader could not start. Review the task log.

source: 引擎读取工具编译后缺少必需产物。
en: Required engine reader build outputs are missing.

source: 当前引擎未声明 DM_INPUT_CONFIG 支持。映射可保存，但游戏将使用引擎自己的默认操作；选择支持该接口的引擎并重新准备后才会应用。
en: This engine does not declare DM_INPUT_CONFIG support. Mappings can be saved, but games use the engine defaults. Select an engine with this interface and prepare the game again to apply mappings.

source: 所选 nxnative 的 Metal 工具链接口不兼容。
en: The selected nxnative Metal toolchain interface is incompatible.

source: 所选 nxnative 的 NSP 读取器入口不兼容。
en: The selected nxnative NSP reader entry point is incompatible.

source: 所选 nxnative 的构建接口或配置不兼容，请查看环境说明并选择完整的兼容源码。
en: The selected nxnative build interfaces or profiles are incompatible. See the environment guide and select complete compatible sources.

source: 检查外部引擎翻译器与所选源码是否一致
en: Check that the external engine translator matches the selected sources

source: 编译外部引擎读取工具
请先准备外部引擎工具
请自行获取并解压完整 nxnative 源码，然后选择包含 dm 和 scripts 的根目录。璃游不附带、不下载引擎，也不修改所选源码。
en: Obtain and extract complete nxnative sources yourself, then select the root containing dm and scripts. LumaDock neither bundles nor downloads the engine and leaves your sources unchanged.

source: 运行引擎由玩家自行提供。
en: Players provide their own runtime engine.

source: 选择 nxnative 源码根目录
选择有效的 nxnative 目录后，点击“准备引擎工具”。首次需要 .NET 10 SDK，并可能从 NuGet 恢复项目依赖。编译产物保存在应用私有缓存，原目录保持不变。
en: Choose a valid nxnative directory, then click Prepare engine tools. The first build needs the .NET 10 SDK and may restore project dependencies from NuGet. Outputs stay in the private app cache; your directory is unchanged.

source: 首次准备引擎读取工具需要 Microsoft .NET 10 SDK（macOS Arm64），只有运行时不够。安装官方 SDK 后重新检查；已有完整工具缓存时不再需要 SDK。安装方法见环境安装说明。
en: Preparing the engine reader for the first time requires the Microsoft .NET 10 SDK for macOS Arm64, not just a runtime. Install the official SDK and check again. A complete cached reader no longer needs the SDK. See the environment installation guide.

source: 下次启动生效，无需重新准备。所选语言需游戏自身支持。
en: Applies on the next launch without preparing again. The game must support the selected language.

source: 与界面语言独立；可在游戏详情中单独设置启动语言。下次启动生效，无需重新准备或导入固件。所选语言需游戏自身支持。
en: Independent of the interface language. Override it in game details. Applies on the next launch without preparing again or importing firmware. The game must support the selected language.

source: 游戏语言代码无效，请在游戏详情中重新选择启动语言。
en: Invalid game language code. Choose a launch language again in game details.

source: 生成用于 iPhone / iPad 的未签名游戏包；安装时需自行签名。
en: Generate an unsigned game package for iPhone / iPad. Sign it with your installation tool.

source: IPA 已生成；安装到 iPhone / iPad 前需自行签名。
en: IPA generated. Sign it before installing on iPhone / iPad.

source: 导出 iPhone / iPad 未签名包；需 Xcode iOS 平台及 XcodeGen。
en: Export an unsigned iPhone / iPad package. Requires the Xcode iOS platform and XcodeGen.

source: 编译 iOS 应用并生成 IPA
en: Build iOS app and generate IPA

source: 请选择 IPA 保存位置。
en: Choose where to save the IPA.

source: IPA 保存位置无效，请选择以 .ipa 结尾的文件。
en: Invalid IPA destination. Choose a file ending in .ipa.

source: 请将 IPA 保存到游戏库、引擎及应用私有目录以外的位置。
en: Save the IPA outside the library, engine and private app directories.

source: 所选 nxnative 缺少 iOS 打包组件，请选择包含 dm/ios 的完整源码。
en: The selected nxnative lacks iOS packaging components. Choose complete sources containing dm/ios.

source: 生成 IPA 需要 XcodeGen，请先运行 brew install xcodegen，再重试。
en: IPA generation requires XcodeGen. Run brew install xcodegen, then retry.

source: iOS 构建环境不完整，请在所选 Xcode 中安装 iOS 平台和 Metal 编译组件，再重试。
en: The iOS build environment is incomplete. Install the iOS platform and Metal compiler in the selected Xcode, then retry.

source: 生成的 IPA 结构或完整性检查失败，请查看任务日志后重试。
en: IPA structure or integrity validation failed. Review the task log, then retry.

source: IPA 保存磁盘空间不足，请释放空间后重试。
en: The IPA destination has insufficient free space. Free space and retry.

source: iOS 着色器产物缺失或编译平台不匹配，请重试。
en: iOS shader outputs are missing or compiled for the wrong platform. Retry the export.
The Metal compiler component is unavailable.

source: 先重新检查 Xcode 和 Metal 组件；若环境通过仍失败，请核对引擎与游戏版本，并查看失败着色器的编译信息。
en: Recheck Xcode and the Metal component. If checks pass but compilation still fails, verify engine/game versions and review the failed shader diagnostics.

source: 关闭占用大量内存的应用后重试；若仍失败，请保留日志检查系统终止原因。
en: Close memory-intensive apps and retry. If it still fails, keep the log and check why the system terminated the process.

source: 在设置中安装 Metal 编译组件，完成后重新检查环境并重试。
en: Install the Metal compiler component in Settings, then recheck the environment and retry.

source: 所需的 Apple 平台 SDK 不可用。
en: The required Apple platform SDK is unavailable.

source: 操作完成，但有警告，请查看任务详情。
en: Completed with warnings. Review the task details.

source: 文件或构建工具访问被拒绝。
en: Access to files or build tools was denied.

source: 构建组件或输入文件缺失。
en: A build component or input file is missing.

source: 构建进程被终止，可能内存不足。
en: The build process was terminated, possibly due to insufficient memory.

source: 查看失败着色器日志，核对游戏和引擎版本后重试；构建完成不代表所有场景的图形效果正常。
en: Review the failed shader log and verify game/engine versions before retrying. A completed build does not guarantee correct graphics in every scene.

source: 查看本任务日志和失败阶段，按提示修复后重试；反馈时复制错误摘要。
en: Review this task's log and failed stage, follow the repair instructions and retry. Copy the error summary when reporting the problem.

source: 查看本任务的具体日志，修复提示的问题后重试；反馈时复制已脱敏的错误摘要。
en: Open this task's log, fix the reported problem and retry. Copy the redacted error summary when reporting it.

source: 核对游戏版本与引擎配置，并确认使用完整的兼容引擎源码；保留日志中的失败着色器信息反馈上游。
en: Verify the game version and engine profile, using complete compatible engine sources. Keep the failed shader details for an upstream report.

source: 检查所选 Xcode；生成 IPA 还需在 Xcode 中安装 iOS 平台，然后重新检查环境。
en: Check the selected Xcode. IPA generation also requires its iOS platform; install it and recheck the environment.

source: 检查游戏库磁盘的读写权限、所选 Xcode 和系统隐私设置，再重试。
en: Check library disk permissions, the selected Xcode and system privacy settings, then retry.

source: 检查磁盘连接、游戏源文件和外部引擎完整性，再重新检查环境；应用内置组件缺失时重新安装完整应用。
en: Check the disk connection, game source files and external engine integrity, then recheck the environment. Reinstall the complete app if bundled components are missing.

source: 没有生成可用的着色器，构建已停止。
en: No usable shaders were generated. The build has stopped.

source: 着色器缓存与当前工具链不一致。
en: The shader cache does not match the current toolchain.

source: 磁盘空间不足，任务已停止。
en: Insufficient disk space. The task has stopped.

source: 部分着色器构建失败：成功 {0}/{1}。
en: Some shaders failed to build: {0}/{1} succeeded.

source: 释放游戏库和导出磁盘的空间后重试；已完成阶段会重新校验。
en: Free space on the library and export disks, then retry. Completed stages will be revalidated.

source: 重新准备引擎工具，再重新准备游戏；不要混用 Mac 与 iOS 的着色器产物。
en: Prepare engine tools again, then prepare the game. Keep Mac and iOS shader outputs separate.

source: 检查完整应用、磁盘连接和权限后重试；查看对应日志了解工作进程退出原因。
en: Check the complete app, disk connection and permissions, then retry. Review the corresponding log for the worker exit reason.

source: 复制 NSP 到游戏库
删除托管 NSP 副本
选择 SAK-Mac 后端目录
导入自己的转换密钥 prod.keys
转换密钥已导入，游戏库密钥保持不变。
en: Conversion keys imported. Library keys are unchanged.

source: 添加 NSP、XCI、NSZ 或 XCZ 文件
en: Add NSP, XCI, NSZ or XCZ files

source: 请选择 NSP、XCI、NSZ 或 XCZ 文件。
en: Choose NSP, XCI, NSZ or XCZ files.

source: 转换完成，可在任务中查看或导入生成的 NSP。
en: Conversion complete. View the results or import the generated NSP files from the task.

source: 转换 NSP / XCI，压缩或解压 NSZ / XCZ，也可合并同一游戏的本体、更新和 DLC。
en: Convert NSP / XCI, compress or decompress NSZ / XCZ, or merge a game's base, updates and DLC.

source: 拖入文件，或点击添加文件。原始文件不会被修改。
en: Drop files here or add them. Original files will not be modified.

source: 一次选择同一游戏的文件；同一内容有多个版本时由后端保留最新版本。
en: Select files for one game. The backend keeps the latest version of duplicate content.

source: 结果写入新的独立文件夹，不覆盖已有输出；转换成功不代表游戏可运行。
en: Results go into a new folder without replacing existing output. Successful conversion does not guarantee a playable game.

source: 转换调度参考 SAK-Mac；实际处理使用你选择的本地 NSC_BUILDER / nsz 后端。
en: Conversion orchestration is adapted from SAK-Mac. Processing uses your selected local NSC_BUILDER / nsz backend.

source: 复用 SAK-Mac 已安装的后端，默认自动识别本机位置；也可选择其他安装目录。无需 Xcode 或 nxnative 即可转换。
en: Use an installed SAK-Mac backend, detected at its default location, or choose another installation. Conversion does not require Xcode or nxnative.

source: 合并至少需要两个文件。
en: Merging requires at least two files.

source: 输出位置必须位于游戏库、私有数据、引擎和转换后端目录之外。
en: Choose an output folder outside the library, private data, engine and conversion backend directories.
The output location is not a folder.

source: 转换后端源码目录不能使用符号链接。
en: The conversion backend source directory cannot be a symbolic link.

source: 转换后端目录过大，请选择 SAK-Mac 安装的后端目录。
en: The conversion backend is too large. Choose SAK-Mac's installed backend directory.

source: 在 SAK-Mac 中安装后端，再在文件转换页面选择其本地后端目录。
en: Install the backend in SAK-Mac, then select its local directory on the conversion page.

source: 导入自己的有效 prod.keys；转换密钥独立保存，不会覆盖已有游戏库密钥。
en: Import your own valid prod.keys. Conversion keys are stored separately and do not replace library keys.

source: 输出磁盘空间不足，转换尚未开始。
en: The output disk has insufficient space. Conversion has not started.

source: 临时文件磁盘空间不足，转换尚未开始。
en: The temporary-files disk has insufficient space. Conversion has not started.

source: 转换输入不能使用符号链接或包含换行的路径。
en: Conversion input cannot use symbolic links or paths containing line breaks.

source: 所选文件格式与转换操作不匹配。
en: The selected file formats do not match the conversion operation.

source: 转换后端在复制时发生变化，请重试。
en: The conversion backend changed while being copied. Try again.

source: 输入文件在复制时发生变化，请重试。
en: An input changed while being copied. Try again.

source: 转换后端包含目录外链接，请重新安装后端。
en: The conversion backend contains an external link. Reinstall the backend.

source: 转换产物不是有效的 PFS0 容器。
en: A conversion result is not a valid PFS0 container.

source: 转换产物的文件表无效。
en: A conversion result has an invalid file table.

source: 转换产物不是有效的 XCI 容器。
en: A conversion result is not a valid XCI container.

source: 另一个转换任务正在运行，请稍后重试。
en: Another conversion is running. Try again later.

source: 转换工具报告错误，产物未导出。
en: The conversion tool reported an error. Results were not exported.

source: 检查自己的密钥、输入文件和转换后端依赖；查看任务日志后重试。
en: Check your own keys, input files and backend dependencies. Read the task log before retrying.

source: 转换工具没有生成有效产物。
en: The conversion tool produced no valid output.

source: 检查自己的密钥与输入格式，查看任务日志中的转换错误后重试。
en: Check your own keys and input formats, then review conversion errors in the task log before retrying.

source: 转换工具生成了符号链接，产物未导出。
en: The conversion tool created a symbolic link. Results were not exported.

source: 导出校验失败，原文件保持不变。
en: Export verification failed. Original files are unchanged.

source: 任务已取消，原文件和已有输出已保留。
en: Task cancelled. Original files and existing output were preserved.

source: 文件转换工具运行失败。
检查转换后端的安装依赖、自己的 prod.keys 和输入文件；查看本任务日志后重试。
en: Check conversion backend dependencies, your own prod.keys and input files. Read this task's log before retrying.

source: 转换密钥缺失、不完整或校验失败。
en: Conversion keys are missing, incomplete or failed validation.

source: 重新导入自己正确且完整的 prod.keys，并确认密钥与输入文件版本匹配。
en: Import your own correct, complete prod.keys again and check that the keys match the input version.

source: SAK-Mac 转换后端与依赖已内置，无需额外安装 Python、Xcode 或 nxnative。导入自己的密钥后即可转换。
en: SAK-Mac conversion tools and dependencies are included. Import your own keys to convert files without installing Python, Xcode or nxnative.

source: 转换功能参考 SAK-Mac，内置 NSC_BUILDER / nsz；第三方来源与许可可在设置中查看。
en: Conversion is adapted from SAK-Mac with bundled NSC_BUILDER / nsz. View third-party sources and licenses in Settings.

source: 重新安装完整的 LumaDock 应用，内置转换组件缺失或损坏。
en: Reinstall the complete LumaDock app. Bundled conversion components are missing or damaged.

source: 确认源文件与已登记的内容一致。
en: Check that source files match their registered content.

source: 解出程序与资源，并合并所需更新。
en: Extract programs and resources, then merge required updates.

source: 准备该游戏已导入的附加内容。
en: Prepare imported additional content for this game.

source: 将游戏程序转换为引擎所需的原生代码。
en: Rewrite game programs into native code for the engine.

source: 采集当前配置所需的运行时着色器。
en: Capture runtime shaders required by the selected profile.

source: 从游戏资源中提取并核对着色器。
en: Extract and check shaders from game resources.

source: 转换着色器并校验已完成的 Metal 产物。
en: Translate shaders and validate completed Metal outputs.

source: 编译并检查 Mac 游戏主程序。
en: Compile and check the Mac game executable.

source: 校验资源并安装到新的运行版本。
en: Validate resources and install a new runtime release.

source: 编译 iPhone 与 iPad 应用并生成安装包。
en: Build and package the iPhone and iPad app.

source: 检查安装包结构与所有成员的完整性。
en: Check package structure and the integrity of every member.

source: 验证复制结果后导出安装包。
en: Verify the copied package before exporting it.

source: 初始参考估时，实际耗时可能变化
en: Initial reference estimate; actual time may vary

source: 里程碑进度，浅色填充为估计
en: Milestone progress; lighter fill is estimated
